mapper.select: SELECT oi.product_id, oi.product_title, oi.product_cover_image, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_amount FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status IN ('pending_shipment', 'shipped', 'completed') GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_title, oi.product_cover_image ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, total_amount DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status IN ('pending_shipment', 'shipped', 'completed')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(o.created_at) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS today_order_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(o.created_at) = CURDATE() THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_revenue, COUNT(1) AS total_order_count, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS total_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status IN ('pending_shipment', 'shipped', 'completed')
